role: Debug tracepoints matching the Java oracle's netherite.oracle.Trace: appends 'label v1 v2 ...' lines with doubles and floats as raw hex bits, so trace_diff can name the first step where native and Java part.
gpu: its former globals, function statics and lazily built tables are gone (lane/gpuenv, L2): per-environment state lives in struct env (csrc/engine/env.h), per-dimension state in the replay's dims, constant tables are built before main; csrc/tests/globals.sh lists what is left
lines 15-28, function mkdir_parent: filesystem writes (mkdir) from trace_open
lines 52-86, function trace: file I/O from inside the tick when a trace is open (a no-op otherwise)
notes: Not a port of vanilla code: it mirrors the harness file oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/Trace.java. trace() is called from many tick files (animals, entity, living, hostiles, ai, spawning, explosion, servertick and others) but only writes when trace_open has been called. Tests listed are those that include trace.h; trace_diff.c compares the two outputs.
